title: Canonical section cocone for a cofiltered limit of etale schemes
statement: Let $R$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $J$ a small cofiltered category, and $B:J\to R_{\Et}$ a diagram of etale schemes over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $B_j\to R$ for the structure maps. Assume each $B_j$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, every transition $B_j\to B_k$ is affine, and $c=(T,(c_j:T\to B_j)_j)$ is a limit cone of the underlying scheme diagram. Let $p:T\to R$ satisfy $c_j$ followed by $B_j\to R=p$ for every $j$. Let $H$ be a sheaf of sets on $R_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Define $\sigma_j:T\to B_j\times_RT$ by components $c_j$ and $\mathrm{id}_T$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the section cocone with vertex $(p^{-1}H)(T)$ by the maps $H(B_j)\to(p^{-1}H)(T)$ sending $s$ to the restriction along $\sigma_j$ of the inverse-image unit section $p^*s$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Then this explicit cocone is a colimit of $B^{\mathrm{op}}\circ H$.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-directed-cofinal] on $J^{\mathrm{op}}$ to choose a single nonempty directed index computing both the limit of the underlying scheme diagram and the colimit of its sections. Choose a stage zero and pass to its cofinal upper tail. Cone and functor laws preserve all structural-map equalities.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-section-continuity] to this inverse system, the inverse image of $H$ on stage zero, and the terminal etale object there. The hypotheses are exactly qcqs stages, affine transitions, and the chosen limit; the identity object has a qcqs structure morphism. The resulting section cocone is limiting as a colimit because its colimit comparison is bijective.

The composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], using $c_j$ followed by the stage structure map equals $p$, identify the stage and limit inverse images with those of $H$. By [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-restriction], the terminal sections at each etale stage are $H(B_j)$. Its unit equation and the composition unit equation identify the stage transitions with restrictions of $H$. The same equations identify a limit component with the inverse-image unit for $p$ restricted along the morphism with projections $c_j$ and the identity, which is $\sigma_j$ by [def-pc-fibre-product]. Thus the identified cocone is the stated one, not an unspecified isomorphic comparison.

Transport the colimit back from the upper tail and directed reindexing. The unit and pullback-projection computation has already identified every component, so the resulting colimit is the explicit section cocone.

lean.statement: theorem cofilteredLimitSections {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] {R : Scheme.{u}} (B : J ⥤ R.Etale) (c : Cone (B ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget R ⋙ Over.forget R)) (p : c.pt ⟶ R) (h : ∀ j, c.π.app j ≫ (B.obj j).hom = p) (H : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) [IsCofiltered J] [∀ j : J, CompactSpace (B.obj j).left] [∀ j : J, QuasiSeparatedSpace (B.obj j).left] [∀ {j k : J} (a : j ⟶ k), IsAffineHom (B.map a).left] (_hc : IsLimit c) : Nonempty (IsColimit (limitSectionCocone B c p h H))
